entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wow! This castle is amazing!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh yeah, we need to start lining[n]up for attractions. Let's decide[n]what we'll go on first.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What kind do you like, [fName]?
I love thrill rides.[clr 27]
I like just walking around.
I want to see the parade.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Totally! They're super scary[n]when you're on them, but also[n]kinda refreshing somehow.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Just to warn you,[n]I scream REALLY loud, okay?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, I agree! I love[n]walking around looking for[n]my favorite characters!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oooh, if we find any of them, we[n]should totally take pictures!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wanna see that too! We should[n]check what time it's at.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Anyway, let's just walk[n]around the park until then.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Um... can I hold your hand?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Y-You know! It's really crowded,[n]so I want to make sure we don't[n]get separated...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Plus... I've been hoping I'd[n]have the opportunity to come[n]here together with you...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Time flies so fast when you're[n]having fun... This really is[n]the kingdom of dreams.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Um, I had a thought cross my mind[n]today... I think I'm at my happiest[n]when I'm with you, [fName].
I feel the same.[clr 27]
I'm glad to hear that.
That's kinda embarrassing.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Really...? I'm so glad.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're amazing, [fName].

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Still, it's the truth...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sometimes I think about what it[n]would have been like had I never[n]met you... It's a scary thought.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I bet I wouldn't have taken[n]my modeling seriously, and[n]eventually given up.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...It's thanks to your support[n]that I can keep pushing forward.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So, thank you... for everything.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Well, it's time for the[n]parade. You wanna go?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Can I... hold your hand again?
